sources.name: Nominatim (OSM geocoding)
sources.notes: Public instance with usage policy; self-host for volume. Addresses → coords for routes, catchments, density.

sources.name: Overpass API (OSM POIs)
sources.notes: Fair-use. Query all amenities of a type in an area: every barber, salon, garage near X. Competitor census without scraping.

sources.name: QLever OSM SPARQL
sources.notes: Planet-scale geo queries (contains/intersects) + federation with Wikidata. Apache-2.0, public endpoint.

sources.name: Wikidata SPARQL
sources.notes: Entity resolution: chains, brands, places. Keyless.

sources.name: cal.diy (MIT scheduling)
sources.notes: ~48k stars. Own the booking widget: no vendor, webhooks on every event. Booking-led templates.

sources.name: Medusa (MIT-core commerce)
sources.notes: 35k stars, agent-optimized + MCP. Own the stack where margins allow instead of renting Shopify.

sources.name: Community ONS MCPs
sources.notes: For MCP-native clients; kernel uses raw APIs.

sources.name: Google Places (reviews/ratings)
sources.notes: H-TASK BOUNDARY: needs billing-enabled key. Do not wire until human approves key creation. Review counts + ratings per venue.
